scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mylyfe/domain && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @mylyfe/api" "npm run dev -w @mylyfe/web"
scripts.build:ios: npm run build -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run build:ios -w @mylyfe/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run build -w @mylyfe/api && npm run build -w @mylyfe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run build -w @mylyfe/domain && npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/api && npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/web && npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/secretary && npm run typecheck -w @mylyfe/mobile
